description: A team runs polls; each person votes once per poll and everyone can see the results.

fields.name: closed
fields.description: false until the poll is closed

entities.name: Option
entities.description: One possible answer of a poll.

entities.name: Vote
entities.description: One person's vote for an option.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: the voter, from the X-User-Id header

endpoints.summary: Add an option to a poll
Votes per option: [{"option_id": int, "label": str, "votes": int}]

rules: user_id is set from the X-User-Id header when the vote is created.
A user can vote only once in a poll: a second vote by the same user for any option of the same poll returns 409.
Voting for an option of a closed poll returns 409.
A new poll has closed false; closing sets closed to true.
GET /polls/{id}/results returns a JSON list with one object per option of that poll: option_id, label and votes (the number of votes, 0 when there are none). An unknown poll returns 404.
poll_id and option_id must refer to existing records; otherwise 404.
